rules.label: Chest pain reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Reported chest discomfort needs immediate clinician assessment.

rules.label: Breathing difficulty reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Reported breathing difficulty needs immediate clinician assessment.

rules.label: Reduced consciousness / fits
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Altered consciousness or seizures need emergency escalation.

rules.label: Heavy bleeding reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Uncontrolled bleeding needs emergency escalation.

rules.label: High fever with stiffness
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Fever combined with stiffness or rash warrants prompt review.

rules.label: Persistent vomiting / dehydration
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Risk of dehydration needs prompt assessment.

rules.label: Reported high BP / sugar reading
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: A reported out-of-range reading needs clinician verification.

rules.label: Symptoms in a young infant
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Young infants can deteriorate quickly — prompt review advised.

rules.label: Fever with rash
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Fever with rash requires clinical assessment to determine urgency.

rules.label: Fever with joint pain
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Fever with joint pain warrants prompt clinical review.

rules.label: Severe headache with neck stiffness
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Severe headache with neck stiffness needs emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Severe headache with vision change
patterns: \b(?:severe headache|worst headache)\b.{0,30}\b(?:vision change|blurred vision|double vision|visual disturbance)\b
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Severe headache with vision changes needs urgent clinician assessment.

rules.label: Sudden weakness on one side
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Sudden one-sided weakness requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Slurred speech
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Slurred speech requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Seizure reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Reported seizure requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Loss of consciousness reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Reported loss of consciousness needs emergency assessment.

rules.label: Severe abdominal pain
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Severe abdominal pain requires urgent clinical evaluation.

rules.label: Abdominal pain with vomiting blood
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Abdominal pain with vomiting blood requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Black stools reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Black or tarry stools require urgent clinical evaluation.

rules.label: Blood in urine reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Blood in urine requires urgent clinical evaluation.

rules.label: Severe back pain with numbness
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Severe back pain with neurological symptoms needs urgent evaluation.

rules.label: Difficulty swallowing
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Difficulty swallowing warrants prompt clinical review.

rules.label: Severe dehydration signs
patterns: \b(?:severe dehydration|sunken eyes|no urine|no tears|very dry mouth|lethargic)\b
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Signs of severe dehydration need urgent clinical assessment.

rules.label: Pregnancy with bleeding
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Bleeding in pregnancy requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Pregnancy with reduced fetal movement
patterns: \b(?:pregnant|pregnancy)\b.{0,30}\b(?:reduced fetal movement|less movement|no movement|baby not moving)\b
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Reduced fetal movement in pregnancy requires urgent evaluation.

rules.label: Infant not feeding
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Infant refusing feeds requires urgent clinical evaluation.

rules.label: Infant with grunting
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Grunting in an infant requires urgent clinical evaluation.

rules.label: Elderly fall with head injury
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Elderly fall with head injury requires urgent evaluation.

rules.label: Poisoning or overdose reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Suspected poisoning or overdose requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Snake bite reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Snake bite requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Dog bite reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Dog bite requires prompt clinical evaluation for rabies prophylaxis.

rules.label: Burns > 10% body surface
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Extensive burns require emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Electric shock reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Electric shock requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Drowning reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Drowning or near-drowning requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Road traffic accident reported
patterns: \b(?:road traffic accident|rta|car accident|vehicle accident|motor vehicle accident)\b
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Road traffic accident requires emergency evaluation.

rules.label: Severe allergic reaction reported
rules.nonDiagnosticNote: Severe allergic reaction requires emergency evaluation.
